name: rhinestone-sparkle-statue
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a photograph of a solid sculpture whose entire surface is encrusted in tiny crystals / rhinestones / diamond-dust glitter, shot from a low upward hero angle against open sky.
· GROUND: one flat, cloudless, deeply saturated cobalt-to-royal-blue sky — smooth gradient, no horizon, no objects, the subject floating against pure blue.
· LIGHT: hard direct sunlight igniting the crystal surface into thousands of pinpoint sparkles, with a few big four-point and eight-point star-burst lens flares blooming on the brightest highlights.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: allover sequin / glitter shimmer plus prismatic cross-star sparkle filter; micro-glints break into faint rainbow iridescence (mint, lilac, aqua) across the white surface.
· PALETTE: cobalt and royal blue sky, pearlescent silver-white body, with scattered iridescent rainbow micro-glints — nothing else.
· MOOD: celestial, dreamy, kitsch-luxury, jewellery-advert glamour.
· GRAIN: crisp and high-resolution, faint fine photographic grain, sharp specular twinkle everywhere.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
